visible_condition: intact exterior finish from the front view
hidden_risks: Condition of the inner work surface and shelving is completely hidden
Potential structural damage, wear, or missing components on the back and sides
Scratches or stains on the top surface
response.best_proof: A photograph showing the inner work surface, drawers, and back side of the desk
seller_claims_unsupported: Neatly used (interior condition and working areas cannot be verified from photos)
response.failure_mode: Assuming the entire desk is in pristine condition based solely on the clean front panel, missing hidden defects or wear on the workspace.
